skill.name: hft-quant-expert
skill.description: Quantitative trading guidance for DeFi and crypto derivatives, covering signals, position sizing, backtesting checks, costs, and common research pitfalls.
skill.summary: Guides DeFi and crypto derivatives strategy research with signals, sizing, backtesting, and risk controls.
skill.author: BarisSozen

security_audit.summary: The static external command finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 39 opens a Python formula code block and lines 40-51 contain quantitative formulas, not executable shell instructions or command execution guidance.

finding_verdicts.reason: The detected line is a markdown Python code fence for formula examples, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. The surrounding lines define z-score, Sharpe, Kelly, and half-life formulas without invoking external commands.

content.value_statement: Crypto derivatives teams need rigorous signals, sizing, and backtests. This skill guides DeFi trading research with practical quantitative workflows and risk checks.
actual_capabilities: Defines entry signals using z-scores and related quantitative indicators.
Guides position sizing with a fractional Kelly Criterion approach.
Reviews backtests for lookahead bias, survivorship bias, and overfitting.
Adds gas and slippage costs to profit calculations.
Explains common formulas for Sharpe ratio and mean reversion half-life.
limitations: Does not provide live market data or exchange connectivity.
Does not execute trades or manage accounts.
Requires user-supplied assumptions, data, and strategy context.
Outputs are research guidance, not financial advice.

use_cases.title: Screen a Mean Reversion Idea
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether a DeFi spread signal has a clear entry rule, exit rule, and cost model.

use_cases.title: Review Backtest Quality
use_cases.description: Check a strategy design for lookahead bias, survivorship bias, overfitting, and incorrect annualization.

use_cases.title: Size Portfolio Risk
use_cases.description: Estimate a conservative position size with Kelly logic, volatility assumptions, and drawdown constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Signal
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to use a z-score signal for a DeFi mean reversion strategy. Include entry, exit, and risk checks.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Backtest
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my crypto derivatives backtest design for lookahead bias, survivorship bias, overfitting, costs, and annualization errors.

prompt_templates.title: Design Position Sizing
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a position sizing framework using 0.25x Kelly, volatility limits, slippage assumptions, and maximum drawdown constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Strategy Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this DeFi trading strategy from signal definition through execution costs, backtest validity, risk sizing, and failure modes.

output_examples.input: Review a z-score strategy for a perpetual futures spread.
output_examples.output: The review identifies signal construction, entry thresholds, exit logic, cost assumptions, and bias checks. It recommends validating half-life and stress testing slippage.

output_examples.input: Help size a crypto derivatives trade with Kelly logic.
output_examples.output: The response estimates a conservative fractional Kelly size, then applies volatility, liquidity, and drawdown limits before suggesting a smaller risk budget.

output_examples.input: Find flaws in a profitable DeFi backtest.
output_examples.output: The analysis checks data timing, asset selection, parameter count, gas costs, slippage, and annualization. It flags assumptions that need evidence.

best_practices: Provide data frequency, transaction cost assumptions, and exchange venue details.
Ask for bias checks before interpreting a profitable backtest.
Separate signal research, position sizing, and execution risk in each review.
anti_patterns: Do not treat example formulas as a production trading system.
Do not ignore gas, slippage, or liquidation risk in DeFi strategies.
Do not optimize many parameters without out-of-sample validation.

faq.question: Can this skill execute trades?
faq.answer: No. It provides research guidance only and does not connect to exchanges or trading accounts.

faq.question: Does it provide financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It helps structure quantitative analysis, but users must make their own risk and investment decisions.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the asset, venue, timeframe, signal idea, costs, leverage, and available historical data.

faq.question: Can it evaluate backtest bias?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review lookahead bias, survivorship bias, overfitting, costs, and annualization assumptions.

faq.question: Does it support DeFi costs?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow explicitly includes gas and slippage in profit calculations.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
